name: GameManager
short: Manage your game library and find games to play with friends.
description: Per-server game library: track owned and installed games with tick-box pickers, rank favorites, find games everyone can play, ping players for a game, schedule play sessions with join buttons and reminders, and vote on what to play. Includes /games slash commands with game-name autocomplete.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores user IDs along with their game ownership, installation status, ranking preferences, and optional timezone. Library data is stored per server and can be cleared by server administrators.
install_msg: Thanks for installing GameManager! Use `[p]games` to get started. Admins add games with `[p]games admin add <game>`. For slash commands, run `[p]slash enable games` and `[p]slash sync`.
author: Quillshot
